LanguageData.VCEV_AlreadyFavourite: {1} is already {0}'s favourite food! The recipe book won't provide further insights
LanguageData.VCEV_HighVarietyThresholdDesc: Colonists with higher food variety than this will get positive mood effects. 60% by default.
LanguageData.VCEV_LowVarietyThresholdDesc: Colonists with lower food variety than this will get negative mood effects. 30% by default.
LanguageData.VCEV_MoodMultiplierDesc: Both negative and positive moods produced by low and high Food Variety need will be multiplied by this number. +/- 5 by default.
LanguageData.VCEV_NewFavouriteGained: {0} has decided that {1} is now their favourite food too!
LanguageData.VCEV_NoMoreFavourites: {0} already has two favourite foods. The recipe book won't provide further insights
LanguageData.VCEV_NumberOfIngredientStacked: Number of ingredient stack per meal (requires reload)
LanguageData.VCEV_NumberOfIngredientStackedDesc: By default, vanilla meals start deleting "common" ingredients after 3 ingredients. This allows you to increase that limit. Requires a mod reload to take effect.
LanguageData.VCEV_NumberOfIngredients: Number of latest ingredients to count
LanguageData.VCEV_NumberOfIngredientsDesc: The food variety need level will be calculated by counting among this number of ingredients consumed. Default is 7 latest ingredients.
LanguageData.VCEV_NumberOfMeals: Number of latest meals to count
LanguageData.VCEV_NumberOfMealsDesc: The food variety need level will be calculated by counting among this number of meals consumed. Default is 7 latest meals.
LanguageData.VCEV_ThisIsFavourite: This is {PAWN_nameDef}'s favourite meal, and counts as two meals for the purpose of food variety.
LanguageData.VCEV_ThisIsFavouriteIng: This is {PAWN_nameDef}'s favourite ingredient, and counts as two ingredients for the purpose of food variety.
LanguageData.VCE_FavouriteFoodEffects: Consuming this meal or ingredient will give a +2 bonus to variety
LanguageData.VCE_IngredientsHasFavourites: Since {0}'s favourite ingredient has been consumed, variety in this category will get a +2 bonus per favourite!
LanguageData.VCE_MealsHasFavourites: Since {0}'s favourite food has been consumed, variety in this category will get a +2 bonus per favourite!
